environment: Linux amd64, OpenJDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.9.9, JavaFX 21.0.5, Monocle headless software rendering

cases.name: overdueScreenShowsStoredDatesAndDays
cases.expected: Overdue table displays a stored loan three days past due.

cases.name: applicationEntryPointShowsFirstRunSetup
cases.expected: Main.start opens a stage with the first-run account form.

cases.name: fullLibrarianAndMemberWorkflow
cases.expected: Actual controls complete setup, catalog/member edits, issue/return, member history and deactivation.

cases.name: invalidBorrowerAndDueDateDoNotChangeCopy
cases.expected: Missing/non-member borrowers and past due dates fail without changing stock.

cases.name: inactiveCopyCannotBeIssuedAndHistoryIsKept
cases.expected: Borrowed copies cannot be deactivated; inactive copies cannot be issued; history remains.

cases.name: failureDuringIssueRollsBackCopyUpdate
cases.expected: Injected insert failure leaves no loan and keeps the copy available.

cases.name: memberCannotCallLibrarianServices
cases.expected: Direct member calls to protected service operations are rejected.

cases.name: logoutRevokesSessionAndOtherAuthCannotReuseIt
cases.expected: Logged-out, null and foreign-service sessions cannot access services.

cases.name: duplicateUsernameIsRejectedIgnoringCase
cases.expected: A duplicate username with different case is rejected.

cases.name: overdueDatesAndDashboardCountsComeFromStorage
cases.expected: A two-day overdue fixture appears with correct overdue and availability counts.

cases.name: searchOverloadsAndUpdates
cases.expected: All-field and field-specific searches work; edits affect results.

cases.name: duplicateIsbnIsRejected
cases.expected: Duplicate ISBN registration fails.

cases.name: invalidBookAndMemberInputsAreRejected
cases.expected: Missing fields and nonexistent update targets are rejected.

cases.name: saltedPasswordHashesAndVerification
cases.expected: Same password has different salted hashes; only the correct password verifies.

cases.name: successfulIssueAndReturnChangesBothRecords
cases.expected: Issue borrows the copy; return records the date and restores availability.

cases.name: duplicateReturnIsRejected
cases.expected: The same loan cannot be returned twice.

cases.name: secondIssueIsRejected
cases.expected: The same copy cannot have a second active loan.

cases.name: memberSearchAndUpdate
cases.expected: Updated name is searchable and updated username can log in.

cases.name: membersSeeOnlyTheirOwnHistory
cases.expected: Members see their own loans and cannot request another member history.

cases.name: databasePreventsDuplicateActiveLoansAndForeignKeyViolations
cases.expected: Database rejects a second active loan and a nonexistent book reference.

cases.name: credentialsAndFirstRunSetup
cases.expected: Valid case-insensitive username works; bad credentials and repeated setup fail.

cases.name: failureDuringReturnRollsBackLoanUpdate
cases.expected: Injected copy-update failure leaves the loan active and copy borrowed.

cases.name: recordsSurviveReopeningDatabase
cases.expected: New repository instance reloads accounts, books, copy state and loans.

cases.name: requiredFieldsAreRejected
cases.expected: A blank title is rejected.

cases.name: invalidIdentityIsRejected
cases.expected: A zero record ID is rejected.

cases.name: polymorphismUsesConcreteRole
cases.expected: Parent references return the concrete account roles; invalid names are rejected.

cases.name: overdueBoundaryAndReturnedLoan
cases.expected: Due today is not overdue; one day late is overdue; a return closes the loan.

cases.name: bookConstructorsAndValidatedUpdates
cases.expected: Default category and valid edits work; an invalid edit preserves earlier details.

cases.name: invalidLoanDatesAreRejected
cases.expected: Invalid due, past return and future return dates are rejected.

cases.name: copyStateTransitionsAreControlled
cases.expected: Borrowed/inactive copies reject invalid transitions.
